verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any policy on whether customer data trains models. Self-hosting and the statement that targeting attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook are related privacy controls, but they do not address AI model training, so they earn no credit. The axis applies because GrowthBook offers a cloud SaaS with AI features such as the AI Visual Editor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
